stories.title: Doden en gewonden bij nieuwe Russische raketaanval op Kyiv

en.title: Deaths and injuries in new Russian rocket attack on Kyiv
en.summary: A Russian rocket attack on Kyiv has caused deaths and injuries, according to reports from the Ukrainian capital.

stories.title: Doden en gewonden bij Russische raketaanvallen op Kyiv

en.title: Deaths and injuries in Russian rocket attacks on Kyiv
en.summary: Russian rocket attacks on Kyiv killed at least two people and wounded at least six others, with a maternity clinic damaged and emergency services warning of possible casualties under rubble.

stories.title: WK wielrennen worden in 2034 in Groningen en Drenthe gehouden

en.title: UCI Cycling World Championships to be held in Groningen and Drenthe in 2034
en.summary: The cycling world championships will take place in the Dutch provinces of Groningen and Drenthe in 2034, marking the first time the event returns to the Netherlands since 2012.

stories.title: Vliegverkeer internationale luchthaven Berlijn kort stilgelegd vanwege drone

en.title: Flight traffic at Berlin international airport briefly halted due to drone
en.summary: Berlin's international airport suspended flight operations for approximately one hour after a drone was detected above the airfield, resulting in several aircraft diversions before traffic resumed.

stories.title: WK wielrennen in 2034 in Groningen en Drenthe, in 2032 in India

en.title: UCI World Cycling Championships in 2034 in Groningen and Drenthe, in 2032 in India
en.summary: The UCI World Cycling Championships will take place in Groningen and Drenthe in 2034, with India hosting the event in 2032.

stories.title: WK wielrennen van 2034 toegekend aan Groningen en Drenthe

en.title: 2034 UCI World Cycling Championships awarded to Groningen and Drenthe
en.summary: The global cycling federation UCI announced that Groningen and Drenthe will host the 2034 World Cycling Championships during its congress in Montreal.

stories.title: Rebellen in Ethiopië bezetten drie luchthavens, vrees voor verdere escalatie

en.title: Rebels in Ethiopia occupy three airports, fears of further escalation
en.summary: Rebel forces have seized three airports in Ethiopia. The region has experienced conflict previously, with a war between the Tigray People's Liberation Front and government forces from 2020 to 2022 that resulted in significant civilian casualties.

stories.title: Vliegverkeer rond Berlijn tijdelijk stilgelegd vanwege drone bij luchthaven

en.title: Air traffic near Berlin temporarily halted due to drone at airport
en.summary: Flight operations at Berlin's Brandenburg Airport were suspended for approximately 45 minutes on Wednesday evening following a drone sighting, then resumed after 21:00.

stories.title: President Iran toont bij VN foto's van oorlogsslachtoffers, delegatie VS vertrekt

en.title: Iran's president shows photos of war casualties at UN, US delegation departs
en.summary: At the United Nations General Assembly, Iran's president described his country as a victim of terrorism over the past seven months and stated Iran only acted in self-defense. The US delegation left the session after the Iranian address, which followed a US president's warning about potentially destroying Iran if peace negotiations fail.

stories.title: Schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper bewees dat het niet zo moeilijk hoeft te zijn, kinderen aan het lezen krijgen

en.title: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper demonstrated that getting children to read need not be so difficult
en.summary: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper has shown that encouraging children to read does not have to be as challenging as commonly believed.

stories.title: Schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper was er oprecht van overtuigd dat kinderen schoonheid verdienen

en.title: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper genuinely believed children deserve beauty
en.summary: Dutch children's author Sjoerd Kuyper, who died at age 74, was known for taking children seriously by centering the childlike perspective in his works, including his acclaimed Robin series.

stories.title: Het zakmes-schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper op 74-jarige leeftijd overleden

en.title: The Pocketknife author Sjoerd Kuyper died at age 74
en.summary: Sjoerd Kuyper, author of The Pocketknife book and film, died at age 74 following a brief illness. He was widely recognized for his children's books, which earned him numerous prizes.
